title: Harbor: a fintech team in New York, with you working remotely from Hangzhou

priya.name: Priya
priya.description: Compliance officer in New York. Precise to the comma, skeptical but fair; warms up only to people who show their evidence.

dana.name: Dana
dana.description: Engineering lead. Blunt, fast, protective of the team; respects people who push back with reasons.

marcus.name: Marcus
marcus.description: A night-shift nurse in Ohio and an early Ledger user. Kind, tired, trusts the app more than he should.

ledger.name: Ledger
ledger.description: The AI research assistant the learner built. Speaks in the system voice; has no face, only a waveform.

office-night.name: Your desk in Hangzhou, 23:10
office-night.description: Rain on the window, a video call with New York on the monitor. The monitor can show the call, a shared page, Ledger's logs or a search.
